summary: After a long wait a voter learns poll workers have run out of one page of the ballot.
realLife: A Chicago voter who waited 40 minutes was told the second ballot page had run out.
sources: NBC Chicago, voting officials under scrutiny over election turnout: https://www.nbcchicago.com/news/politics/Voting-Officials-Under-Scrutiny-Election-Turnout-499758361.html
inGame: needs: ballot supply at a polling place; the voting module's ballot rows

turns.turn: The page is found in a minute
